summary: The appeals challenged the High Court's review judgment allowing re-adjudication of surrender of protected tenancy rights from 1967. Key issues: maintainability of successive review petitions under Order XLVII Rule 1 CPC; authenticity of 1967 surrender; procedural fairness. Court held second review impermissible as no new evidence or error on record; earlier 2013 judgment restoring tenancy was wrongly overturned. Reasoning emphasized limited scope of review and prohibition on re-agitation of dismissed grounds. Outcome: appeals allowed, impugned review set aside.
legal_provisions_cited: A.P. (Telangana Area) Tenancy and Agricultural Lands Act, 1950
Andhra Pradesh Land Reforms (Ceiling on Agricultural Holdings) Act, 1973
final_judgment: Appeals allowed. The impugned judgment allowing review petitions is set aside. The common judgment dated 09.07.2013 passed by the High Court is restored.
